# Arda Karaduman

> arda.tr is the personal site of Arda Karaduman, a systems architect in Tokyo. He has lived in Japan since 2004. The page lists his systems work, products, games, writing, tools and music, and links to his résumé, blog and AI chat.

## Sections

- [Catalogue](https://arda.tr/#catalogue): Systems, products, games, writing, tools and music in one grid
- [Record](https://arda.tr/#record): Career background: Systems Architect at Veltra, Keio University, earlier roles
- [Contact](https://arda.tr/#contact): Email and social links

## Sites

- [Résumé](https://resume.arda.tr/): Work history, skills and education, with PDF, DOCX and JSON downloads in English, Japanese and Turkish
- [Blog](https://blog.arda.tr/): Coze, posts on AI tooling, Go, DevOps, home networking and generative music since 2010
- [AI chat](https://ai.arda.tr/): Answers questions about Arda's work, projects and music
- [Arda](https://lind.arda.tr/): Songs in Tolkien's Sindarin, with Tengwar lyrics and English translations

## Projects

- [Gand](https://gand.tr/): Independent software studio
- [Gand Games](https://gand.games/): Games label of Gand
- [G Copy](https://g-copy.gand.games/): Floppy-disk copying business game after X-Copy, playable in the browser
- [King](https://king.arda.tr/): Turkish trick-taking card game, 20 hands of penalties and trumps against three computer players, in the browser
- [Gage](https://gage.coze.org/): Chess on X with no Twitter API, via a browser extension
- [Skriv.ist](https://skriv.ist/): Multiplatform ebook reader
- [Skrivist Books](https://books.skriv.ist/): Local-only EPUB and PDF reader with OPDS and an offline PWA, no accounts
- [Armarium](https://armarium.skriv.ist/): Small self-hosted library server for comics and ebooks, with OPDS, a JSON API and a web reader
- [Fablespun](https://fable.tr/): Illustrated fables for kids, generated with AI
- [Vigil Today](https://vigil.today/): Reminder widget PWA for recurring tasks
- [SUDONE](https://sudone.jp/): Scan a shelf barcode in a shop and check whether the price beats online
- [dergi.coze.org](https://dergi.coze.org/): Turkish Commodore 64 and Amiga magazines from 1985 on, every issue page by page and every article searchable
- [RETRO](https://retro.coze.org/): Monthly Turkish magazine on games, metal, hardware and AI, written by AI in the voice of a 90s print magazine
- [Pagan](https://pagan.tr/): Turkish black metal band, official site
- [Reliquary](https://github.com/c0ze/reliquary): Self-hosted AI memory server (MCP)
- [tincan](https://github.com/c0ze/tincan): Message passing between AI coding agents through a spool on disk
- [tenioha](https://c0ze.github.io/tenioha/): Experimental functional language with Japanese particles in function signatures
- [cozy-tracker](https://tracker.coze.org/): Adaptive game music with Impulse Tracker modules
